groundTruth.polygonPx: ordered original-image [x,y] vertices; approximate full extent, not visible-pixel mask

terrain.terrain: unchanged legacy label; fixed aliases below

number-token.number: literal integer from old independent label, visually reconfirmed

geometryMatching.method: Maximum-total-IoU one-to-one assignment within component kind; only geometry is used. GT polygon is reduced to axis-aligned envelope for box-to-box comparison.
geometryMatching.predictionBoxOrder: box_1000=[ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax] converted once by width/height, no clipping/answer-driven adjustment
geometryMatching.ties: equal optimal assignment or visually indeterminate object correspondence => AMBIGUOUS; do not use values to break ties
geometryMatching.nullBoxes: unlocalized; no nearest matching by printed value
geometryMatching.limitation: Approximate manual envelopes, foreground occlusion and neighboring hex bbox overlap; not precision masks. Center-only containment is not the primary matcher.

annotationMethod.method: Independent direct original plus fixed 2x crop visual review; manual object extents before new model responses. No OCR/model/prediction boxes used.
annotationMethod.coordinates: original pixels; bboxPx=[xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]; polygonPx ordered vertices; approximate extents, not segmentation masks
annotationMethod.labelReuse: Old independent labels preserved; visually confirmed without rewriting old GT.

edition.observed: Korean cards, sculpted plastic villages/cities; full 19-hex basic island. Not demonstrated 2025 printing.
edition.doNotInfer: Caption, game rules and stock maxima are not used to force object values.

inspectionTransformAdditional.purpose: Confirm bottom physical tile edges without prediction input

D4.reason: No confirmed evaluation frame for this task; no frame created.
